---
title: "A word wider than its column"
mdbrand:
  brand: none
  style: note
lang: es
---

The author's dashes give the status column 2% of the measure. Typst cannot
break "Condicionado" and set it into the description beside it, exit 0.

| Estado | Descripción |
|:-|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Condicionado | The second phase waits on the field trial and on the certificates the client's operations team issues for the new gateways |
| Aceptado | The first phase starts in November with the metering protocols and the border routers already in the field |
